label: 6. and they can make some new friends.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: and they can make some new friends.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: I can bring my sea creatures with me,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: what activities should we get up to?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: So,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: when we go to the beach this summer,
What is going on?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Oh, sorry.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: The signal started acting up,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: so the messages got sent out of order.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: So, when we go to the beach this summer, what activities should we get up to? I can bring my sea creatures with me, and they can make some new friends.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: That's the order they should have been in.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: I guess my being a maid has weakened my abilities,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: and the signal is being negatively affected.
Ha, you think so?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Yeah.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Trony says that when you change jobs,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: your stats and skills change along with it.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: So I'm unable to use my radar skills right now,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: which would explain

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: why the signal's all wonky.
But shouldn't you have obtained new maid skills in their place?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: You're right, and not just any ordinary maid's skills.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: I've obtained those as part of a secret profession:

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: A swimsuit-clad maid!
Wow, very nice!

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Swimsuit maids aren't as proficient at normal maid-based skills,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: but they get a serious power boost

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: when they're near water.
Does that include places like swimming pools?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Yeah, as long as it's water, it counts.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: So it seems like I'm stronger

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: in the kitchen, which has a sink, than the hall, which doesn't.
Then at the beach, you'll be way stronger, right?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: I can only imagine!

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: But this time, instead of horsing around,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: I'm really gonna focus on my maid-related tasks.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Cooking, cleaning, organizing,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: taking the starfish for a walk,

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: hunting for sea creatures.
Those last two parts don't sound quite right...
Are those all really maid-related tasks?

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: A true maid is capable of doing anything.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: At least that's what Ade told me.
There's an element of truth to that, but...

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: ... Yes?
Anyway, I'm sure you've made a lot of new friends recently.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: I have, but you're still the apple of my eye, Master.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: In fact, can I come over now?
Sure.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: All right, I'll be there soon.

lines.speaker: anchor_m
lines.text: Don't miss me too much in the meantime.
Haha, all right.
